newsitem.title: UK: UK'S LABOUR PLANS NO CURB ON TOBACCO SPONSORSHIP.
newsitem.headline: UK'S LABOUR PLANS NO CURB ON TOBACCO SPONSORSHIP.

text.p: Britain's Labour Party has no plans to restrict corporate sponsorship by tobacco companies of sports events if it wins the next election, a Labour MP said on Thursday.
"Labour has no plans for the restriction of tobacco sponsorship in sport...," Kate Hoey, Labour's Member of Parliament for Vauxhall, told a business conference in London.
